examples.english: They took Karim to the doctor quickly.
examples.transliteration: Homa waddaw Karim lel doktor be sor3a.

examples.arabic: منى وصلت، قلقانة. صباح الخير يا دكتور! قالت.
examples.english: Mona arrived, anxious. "Good morning, Doctor!" she said.
examples.transliteration: Mona wasalet, qalqana. "Sabah el-kheir ya doctor!" qalet.
